audit_scope: Worker-4 source-reviewed APD6 row reconciliation against primary XML/PDF/Fig. 1/Fig. 2 plus merged APD6 activity/sequence exports. Packet database snapshots were read-only inputs.

record_audits.database_subject: Amolopin (UCLL1c; natural AMPs; frog, amphibians, animals; XXA)
record_audits.database_measure: anti-diabetes; APD6 text notes insulin release in INS-1 cells and interest for type 2 diabetes

sequence_check.agreement: linear residue string agrees, but primary source C-terminal amidation is not represented in the APD6 plain sequence field

source_locator.primary_source_statement: Primary source reports amolopin as FLPIVGKSLSGLSGKL with C-terminal amidation.

source_organism_check.primary_source: skin secretion of Amolops loloensis collected in Yunnan Province of China

activity_check.primary_source_activity: insulin release stimulation in INS-1 cells
activity_check.scope_caution: Primary paper does not report antimicrobial MIC/MBC/hemolysis/cytotoxicity assays for amolopin.

record_audits.conflict_context: APD6 stores the linear sequence without the C-terminal NH2 modification that the primary paper reports; this is preserved as sequence_modified_not_normalized rather than silently normalized.
record_audits.review_notes: APD6 anti-diabetes/insulin-release annotation is supported at paper level, but antimicrobial activity must not be inferred from APD/CAMP naming or similarity to temporins.
